Third development release of 0.18.0: SNMP for virtual machines through Outposts, moving a rack to another site, and fixes for the bugs reported against dev2.

> [!CAUTION]
> **This is a development release. It is not stable and it contains bugs.** Do not run it in production or on data you can't restore. Take a backup before upgrading a test install, and expect behaviour to change before 0.18.0. If you run into a problem, please [submit a bug report](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) - every report helps get 0.18.0 right.

Everything in [0.18.0-dev1](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/releases/tag/v0.18.0-dev1) and [0.18.0-dev2](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/releases/tag/v0.18.0-dev2) is included; read their notes for the full list.

### Features

- #325 - **Virtual machines poll SNMP through their site's Outpost,** on the same engine as devices: Poll now, scheduled polling and the Outpost work list treat devices and VMs alike. A VM uses its own site, or its cluster's site, to find its Outpost, and its SNMP page shows "Polls from Outpost …" or "Polls from the core". A VM is polled on schedule when it has an SNMP profile on the VM, its platform or its cluster, or was polled before. Outposts need no update.
- #394 - **Move a rack to another site** with all its devices, keeping their positions. **Move to site…** on the rack page shows what moves and lists anything still tied to the old site (cables leaving the rack, VLANs or IPs of the old site, power feeds, clusters) before anything changes. API: `POST /api/racks/<id>/move/`.
- #396 - **Copy buttons** on site and contact addresses.

### Fixed

- #398 - **Unlinking an Oxidized node and pinning it again gets the same check as moving the link,** so it can't reveal another object's config.
- #399 - **Sync no longer hands a node's config to an object created to match it.** A new match for a node Oxidized already knew is a proposed link: it shows no config until someone with change rights on the connection confirms it. First syncs, new nodes and a node returning to its old object still link at once.
- #400 - **A VM or device with the same name no longer removes an existing Oxidized link;** the namesake shows as a warning on the sync.
- #401 - **The email template preview shows behind nginx and other reverse proxies.**
- **Oxidized automatic sync columns get database defaults,** so an upgrade doesn't break processes still on the old release.

Thank you @SerhiiZahuba and @deku-m for the reports and requests.
